verdict.rationale: BigCommerce documents non-interactive operation: REST and GraphQL APIs manage products, orders, customers and settings programmatically, and the platform explicitly supports automating store processes and going fully headless. Scoped OAuth API accounts, sandbox/trial stores for testing without touching live data, webhooks and language API clients make scripted pipelines feasible. One community report of API throttling and dropped connections is anecdotal and does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: a documented CLI or explicit CI/CD integration guidance (e.g. a theme/deploy CLI for pipelines), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
